CORRECTION_TO_CYCLE_106_ROOT_CAUSE.c106_claimed: the Gumroad API silently discards product writes - dashboard-only, BLOCKED
CORRECTION_TO_CYCLE_106_ROOT_CAUSE.truth: that conclusion was WRONG, and the cause was mine. Gumroad expects FLAT keys ('description=...'), not the nested 'product[description]' shape I sent. With the flat shape the write persists immediately.
CORRECTION_TO_CYCLE_106_ROOT_CAUSE.how_proven: PUT /v2/products/<product_id> with a flat description key, re-read after 25s: probe persisted. The original live description was then restored byte-for-byte.
CORRECTION_TO_CYCLE_106_ROOT_CAUSE.consequence: product copy can be fixed autonomously. No founder dashboard action was ever needed for it. C106 handed the founder a task that does not exist, and C107 repeated it.
CORRECTION_TO_CYCLE_106_ROOT_CAUSE.api_shape_note: update_product() in channels/gumroad_publisher.py already builds flat keys correctly - my probe bypassed the repo's own helper and used the wrong shape. The repo code was right; the ad-hoc probe was wrong.

CUSTOMER_RESEARCH_REAL_EVIDENCE.method: live web search for actual buyer pain, actual buying behaviour, and actual competitors in the Etsy-suspension niche
demand_confirmed: r/EtsyCommunity and r/EtsySellers carry active suspension threads, including 2026-dated posts
the pain is concrete and repeated: suspended with no reason given, appeal rejected or ignored, fee lost, income stopped
quotes captured verbatim: 'They just took my money and now I can't even contact anyone', 'my whole career is currently hanging in the balance', 'The whole thing just seems very unfair to me'

PAYMENT_PROOF_FOUND.what_they_sell: 'Shopkeep Sentry turns your suspension notice into a complete, ready-to-submit appeal built on this exact structure - in about five minutes'
PAYMENT_PROOF_FOUND.why_this_matters: a live, operating business is charging money to solve exactly this problem. That is real proof of willingness to pay in this niche, not an assumption. It is the strongest demand signal found in any cycle so far.
PAYMENT_PROOF_FOUND.their_gap_we_can_own: they run an AI generator plus a free policy library as a lead magnet. Our offer is a one-time owned file with 11 checklists and no subscription, no tool, no account. That is a genuine positioning difference, not a cosmetic one.

official_policy_facts_that_strengthen_th.source: help.etsy.com - How to File an Appeal for a Permanently Suspended Account
official_policy_facts_that_strengthen_th.six_month_window: 'You have 6 months from the day your account was suspended to file an appeal. If you miss this window, your account will remain permanently suspended.'
official_policy_facts_that_strengthen_th.temporary_vs_permanent: a temporary suspension is resolved by other means (clearing a balance or an open case) and should NOT be appealed
official_policy_facts_that_strengthen_th.file_after_fixing: Etsy's own guidance is to file only after resolving the issues that caused the suspension - which is exactly why a preparation kit is the thing a buyer needs
official_policy_facts_that_strengthen_th.consistent_with_our_asset: our file already carried the 6-month window; it is now stated up front on the product page as the hook, sourced from Etsy's own policy rather than asserted

competing_niche_rejected.why_rejected: every result is a free lead magnet from an HR/insurance/accounting SaaS trying to sell software (OneDigital, BBSI, CorpNet, benely, easyb, wintive). The checklist itself is never the product. Hard to monetise a PDF when the checklist is the advertisement.

CUSTOMER_RESEARCH_REAL_EVIDENCE.best_niche_conclusion: Etsy suspension appeal. It is the only niche researched this cycle with hard evidence of someone actually paying to solve it, an active and reachable buyer community, a real and verifiable deadline that creates genuine urgency, and a product we already own, have already distributed, and can therefore improve and re-sell immediately.

fgruzn_etsy_suspension_appeal_kit.adds: temporary vs permanent triage, the Appeals Center walkthrough in Etsy's own question order, explicit differentiation from paid AI appeal generators ('a file you own and use once'), and a plain What is NOT included block

Building a fourth product would add inventory while the measured bottleneck remains reach and checkout confirmation. The highest-value production available was making the two existing offers actually sellable, which is now done.
